title: The Pond & Path
description:
Escape the hustle and unwind on this property just 20 miles from Nashville. This walkout basement apartment features a private entrance and private pond. 
Wake up to the sound of birds, enjoy your coffee overlooking the water, and watch deer wander the yard. Guests are welcome to walk the trails, feed the deer, or simply relax.
Whether you’re in town to explore, visit family, or simply unwind we offer the best of both worlds peaceful country living with city convenience just minutes away.

The space
This is a basement unit with private entrance. Owner occupies main level of property. There is a secondary Airbnb on this property located above the garage.

Guest access
Guess have access to lower level patio and basement unit. Please drive all the way down driveway to the back of the house.

Other things to note
This is a secondary basement unit of a primary residence. You might occasionally hear footsteps above you.
